S.FORM: Kingdalruwane Itiniay i Sandimen Cen no Pingtung ko Kingdalruwane a niyaro', 17 ko sa'osi no parod no loma', 62 ko sa'osi no tamdaw. 98% ko ka'aloman no Yincomin , polong han i, 61 ko tamdaw; o roma sato i, 2% ko ka'aloman no roma a finacadan, polong han i, 1 ko tamdaw. O pa-sin-to no ka'aloman no tamdaw no kasafinacadan i, ko Rukai 66%, Paiwan 21%, roma 11%.
